deleted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_tasks.deleted_at column. Nullable DateTime timestamp for soft deletion. Null means task is active. Non-null indicates soft-deleted task.

project.description: The project this task belongs to. Tasks must belong to exactly one project.
project.x-autobe-specification: Transformed from hrm_platform_project_id foreign key column. JOIN with hrm_platform_projects table on hrm_platform_project_id = projects.id. Returns IHrmPlatformProject.ISummary with project identification details (id, name, status, color_code, budget_hours, created_at).

assignedEmployee.description: The employee assigned to this task. Optional - task may remain unassigned. Employee must be a member of the project.
assignedEmployee.x-autobe-specification: Transformed from assigned_employee_id foreign key column. LEFT JOIN with hrm_platform_employees table on assigned_employee_id = employees.id. Returns IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary if assigned, null if unassigned. Employee must be a member of the task's project.

parentTask.description: Parent task if this task is a subtask. Optional - if set, this task is a subtask of the parent. Subtasks cannot have their own subtasks.
parentTask.x-autobe-specification: Transformed from parent_task_id foreign key column. LEFT JOIN with hrm_platform_tasks table on parent_task_id = tasks.id (self-referential). Returns IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary if this is a subtask, null if this is a parent task. Subtasks cannot have their own subtasks (one level only).

createdByMember.description: The member who created this task. Automatically set from the authenticated user who created the task.
createdByMember.x-autobe-specification: Transformed from created_by_member_id foreign key column. JOIN with hrm_platform_members table on created_by_member_id = members.id. Returns IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary with creator identity information. Auto-populated from authenticated member's ID on task creation.

IHrmPlatformTask.description: Complete task entity representing a discrete unit of work within a project. Tasks are the smallest unit of work tracking with status progression, priority classification, and optional subtask relationships. Each task belongs to exactly one project, may be assigned to an employee who is a member of that project, and may have an optional parent task for one-level subtask hierarchy. The task includes references to the parent project, assigned employee (if any), parent task (if this is a subtask), and the member who created the task. Task status tracks workflow progression through states like open, in-progress, completed, or closed. Priority classification enables work ordering with values like low, medium, high, or urgent.
IHrmPlatformTask.x-autobe-specification: Query hrm_platform_tasks table for a single task record by UUID. Join with hrm_platform_projects for project details (via hrm_platform_project_id), hrm_platform_employees for assigned employee (via assigned_employee_id, nullable), hrm_platform_tasks for parent task (via parent_task_id, nullable), and hrm_platform_members for creator member (via created_by_member_id). Exclude soft-deleted records (deleted_at IS NULL). Return complete task object with all fields and related data references. Do not include subtasks array or taskHistories array - these are accessed via separate endpoints (GET /tasks/{taskId}/subtasks, GET /tasks/{taskId}/histories).

id.description: Unique identifier for this field-level change record.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_log_changes.id. Primary key, UUID format. Immutable identifier for this change record.

hrm_platform_activity_log_id.description: UUID of the parent activity log entry that contains this field-level change.
hrm_platform_activity_log_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_log_changes.hrm_platform_activity_log_id. Foreign key reference to the parent activity log entry. Used with field_name in composite unique constraint.

field_name.description: Name of the field that was modified in the target entity.
field_name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_log_changes.field_name. String field identifying which attribute was modified (e.g., 'status', 'title', 'assigned_to', 'end_date'). Part of composite unique constraint with hrm_platform_activity_log_id.

old_value.description: Previous value of the field before the change. Null if the field was newly created.
old_value.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_log_changes.old_value. Nullable string field containing the value before the change. Null for newly created fields that had no prior value. Stored as string regardless of original field type for audit trail consistency.

new_value.description: New value of the field after the change. Null if the field value was deleted or removed.
new_value.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_log_changes.new_value. Nullable string field containing the value after the change. Null for deleted fields or when a value is removed. Stored as string regardless of original field type for audit trail consistency.

field_type.description: Data type of the changed field (e.g., string, int, datetime, boolean, uuid).
field_type.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_log_changes.field_type. String field indicating the data type of the changed field (e.g., 'string', 'int', 'datetime', 'boolean', 'uuid'). Provides context for interpreting the old and new values.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this field-level change was recorded.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_log_changes.created_at. DateTime field with timestamptz database type. Immutable timestamp recording when this change was made. Used for audit trail chronological ordering.

IHrmPlatformActivityLogChange.description: A field-level change record within an activity log entry. This represents a single attribute modification that occurred during a business action, such as an employee status change, contract edit, project update, or task status transition. Each change record captures the field name, previous value, new value, data type, and timestamp for comprehensive audit trail tracking and compliance purposes.
IHrmPlatformActivityLogChange.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_activity_log_changes table. All fields are read-only as this is an immutable audit trail record. Query by primary key (id) with verification that the change belongs to the specified parent activity log using the composite unique constraint (hrm_platform_activity_log_id, field_name). Enforce organization-level access control via parent activity log relationship - users can only view changes from activity logs within their own organization. The activityLog relation is not exposed as an object; instead, the foreign key hrm_platform_activity_log_id is provided as a scalar for clients to access the parent activity log through separate endpoints.

hoursWorkedToday.description: Total hours worked by the employee on the current day, calculated by summing all timelog durations and converting from minutes to hours. Rounded to 2 decimal places for display.
hoursWorkedToday.x-autobe-specification: Query hrm_platform_timelogs where hrm_platform_employee_id = authenticated employee AND date = current date (truncated to day). Sum duration (minutes), divide by 60, round to 2 decimal places. Return 0 if no timelogs exist for today.

hoursWorkedThisWeek.description: Total hours worked by the employee during the current week (Monday through Sunday), calculated by summing all timelog durations and converting from minutes to hours. Rounded to 2 decimal places for display.
hoursWorkedThisWeek.x-autobe-specification: Calculate week start (Monday of current week). Query hrm_platform_timelogs where hrm_platform_employee_id = authenticated employee AND date >= week_start AND date < next_week_start. Sum duration, divide by 60, round to 2 decimal places. Return 0 if no timelogs exist for the current week.

activeTimer.description: Current active timer session if the employee has a running timer. Contains timer details including start time, associated project, and optional task. Returns null if no timer is currently running.
activeTimer.x-autobe-specification: Query hrm_platform_timers where hrm_platform_employee_id = authenticated employee AND stopped_at IS NULL. If found, return IHrmPlatformTimer.ISummary object with timer details including started_at, project_id, task_id, project_name, task_title via JOINs. If not found, return null.

recentTimelogs.description: Recent time entries from the past 7 days, showing the employee's most recent work activities. Includes project and task context for each timelog. Ordered by date descending, limited to 10 entries for display efficiency.
recentTimelogs.x-autobe-specification: Query hrm_platform_timelogs where hrm_platform_employee_id = authenticated employee AND date >= (current_date - 7 days) AND deleted_at IS NULL. ORDER BY date DESC, limit 10. JOIN hrm_platform_projects for project info, LEFT JOIN hrm_platform_tasks for task info. Return as IHrmPlatformTimelog array with full timelog details including project and task references.

pendingTimesheets.description: List of timesheets submitted by the employee that are currently awaiting manager approval. Each entry shows the week covered, total hours logged, and submission timestamp. Ordered by most recently submitted first.
pendingTimesheets.x-autobe-specification: Query hrm_platform_timesheets where hrm_platform_employee_id = authenticated employee AND status = 'submitted' AND deleted_at IS NULL. Include id, week_start_date, total_hours, submitted_at. ORDER BY submitted_at DESC. Return as IHrmPlatformTimesheet.ISummary array for timesheets awaiting manager approval.

assignedTasks.description: Tasks assigned to the employee across all projects they are a member of. Ordered by due date (ascending, with null dates last) and priority (descending: critical, high, medium, low). Limited to 10 tasks to show the most urgent work items first.
assignedTasks.x-autobe-specification: Query hrm_platform_tasks where assigned_employee_id = authenticated employee AND deleted_at IS NULL. Filter to tasks where hrm_platform_project_id is in (SELECT project_id FROM hrm_platform_project_memberships WHERE employee_id = authenticated employee AND deleted_at IS NULL). Include id, title, status, priority, due_date, project_id. JOIN hrm_platform_projects for project_name. ORDER BY due_date ASC NULLS LAST, priority DESC (critical > high > medium > low). Limit 10. Return as IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary array.

IHrmPlatformPersonalDashboard.description:
Personal dashboard providing a comprehensive overview of the authenticated employee's work status and activity. This aggregated view includes hours worked today and this week, current active timer status if running, recent time entries from the past 7 days, pending timesheets awaiting approval, and assigned tasks with deadlines.

The dashboard serves as the primary landing view for employees to quickly assess their work progress, identify pending actions (such as timesheets needing approval or tasks approaching deadlines), and monitor their time tracking activities. All data is scoped to the authenticated employee's organization context and respects role-based access control permissions.
IHrmPlatformPersonalDashboard.x-autobe-specification:
Aggregate personal dashboard data from multiple tables for the authenticated employee:

1. hoursWorkedToday: Query hrm_platform_timelogs where hrm_platform_employee_id = authenticated employee AND date = current date (truncated to day). Sum duration (minutes), divide by 60, round to 2 decimal places. Return 0 if no timelogs exist.

2. hoursWorkedThisWeek: Calculate week start (Monday of current week). Query hrm_platform_timelogs where hrm_platform_employee_id = authenticated employee AND date >= week_start AND date < next_week_start. Sum duration, divide by 60, round to 2 decimal places. Return 0 if no timelogs exist.

3. activeTimer: Query hrm_platform_timers where hrm_platform_employee_id = authenticated employee AND stopped_at IS NULL. If found, return IHrmPlatformPersonalDashboard.IActiveTimer object with timer id, started_at, project_id, task_id (optional), and JOIN hrm_platform_projects for project_name, JOIN hrm_platform_tasks for task_title. If not found, return null.

4. recentTimelogs: Query hrm_platform_timelogs where hrm_platform_employee_id = authenticated employee AND date >= (current_date - 7 days) AND deleted_at IS NULL. ORDER BY date DESC, limit 10. JOIN hrm_platform_projects for project info, LEFT JOIN hrm_platform_tasks for task info. Return as IHrmPlatformTimelog array.

5. pendingTimesheets: Query hrm_platform_timesheets where hrm_platform_employee_id = authenticated employee AND status = 'submitted' AND deleted_at IS NULL. Include id, week_start_date, total_hours, submitted_at. ORDER BY submitted_at DESC. Return as IHrmPlatformTimesheet.ISummary array.

6. assignedTasks: Query hrm_platform_tasks where assigned_employee_id = authenticated employee AND deleted_at IS NULL. Filter to tasks where hrm_platform_project_id is in (SELECT project_id FROM hrm_platform_project_memberships WHERE employee_id = authenticated employee AND deleted_at IS NULL). Include id, title, status, priority, due_date, project_id. JOIN hrm_platform_projects for project_name. ORDER BY due_date ASC NULLS LAST, priority DESC (critical > high > medium > low). Limit 10. Return as IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary array.

Error handling: Return 404 if employee not found in organization context. Return 403 if employee status is 'deactivated'. Handle all null/empty cases gracefully.

group_type.description: The grouping dimension for the time report. Determines whether the report aggregates time data by employee, project, or task. This value matches the group_type parameter from the report request.
group_type.x-autobe-specification: Computed from the GROUP BY dimension selection in the report query. Value is 'employee' when grouping by hrm_platform_employee_id, 'project' when grouping by hrm_platform_project_id, or 'task' when grouping by hrm_platform_task_id. This determines which entity's data is aggregated in each report row.

group_id.description: The unique identifier of the grouped entity. This is the employee ID, project ID, or task ID depending on the group_type. Used to identify which specific entity this report entry represents.
group_id.x-autobe-specification: Computed from the GROUP BY key based on group_type. When group_type is 'employee', this is hrm_platform_employee_id. When 'project', this is hrm_platform_project_id. When 'task', this is hrm_platform_task_id. This is the unique identifier of the entity being reported on.

group_name.description: The human-readable name of the grouped entity. This is the employee's name, project name, or task name depending on the group_type. Used for display purposes in reports and dashboards.
group_name.x-autobe-specification: Computed from JOIN with the appropriate entity table based on group_type. When group_type is 'employee', this comes from hrm_platform_employees (typically display_name or full name). When 'project', this is hrm_platform_projects.name. When 'task', this is hrm_platform_tasks.name. Provides human-readable identification of the grouped entity.

total_hours.description: Total hours worked by the grouped entity (employee, project, or task) within the report date range. This includes all time entries regardless of billable status, represented in hours with decimal precision.
total_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SUM(duration) / 60.0. Sums all timelog duration values (stored in minutes) for the grouped entity within the specified date range, then divides by 60 to convert to hours. Includes both billable and non-billable time entries.

billable_hours.description: Total billable hours for the grouped entity within the report date range. This includes only time entries marked as billable, representing chargeable work time in hours with decimal precision.
billable_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SUM(CASE WHEN billable = true THEN duration ELSE 0 END) / 60.0. Sums only the duration values from timelogs where billable = true for the grouped entity within the date range, then divides by 60 to convert to hours.

non_billable_hours.description: Total non-billable hours for the grouped entity within the report date range. This includes only time entries marked as non-billable, representing internal or administrative work time in hours with decimal precision.
non_billable_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SUM(CASE WHEN billable = false THEN duration ELSE 0 END) / 60.0. Sums only the duration values from timelogs where billable = false for the grouped entity within the date range, then divides by 60 to convert to hours.

entry_count.description: The total number of individual time entries (timelogs) that contribute to this report entry. This count helps understand the granularity of time tracking for the grouped entity.
entry_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: COUNT(*). Counts the total number of timelog records for the grouped entity within the specified date range. This represents how many individual time entries contribute to the aggregated hours.

weekly_summary.description: Optional week-by-week breakdown of hours for the grouped entity. When included, provides a detailed view of how time was distributed across individual calendar weeks within the report date range. Only present when explicitly requested in the report parameters.
weekly_summary.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', date) within each group. Only included when weekly_summary is requested in IHrmPlatformTimeReport.IRequest. Creates a week-by-week breakdown showing hours per calendar week for the entire date range. Each weekly summary entry contains week_start_date, total_hours, billable_hours, and non_billable_hours for that specific week.

IHrmPlatformTimeReport.description:
Time tracking report entry representing aggregated time data grouped by employee, project, or task dimension. Each entry contains the grouping identifier and name, along with aggregate metrics including total hours worked, billable hours, non-billable hours, and the count of time entries. When weekly summary is requested, includes a week-by-week breakdown of hours for the entire date range.

This report type is used for analytical purposes to understand time allocation patterns, track project budgets, and analyze employee productivity. The grouping dimension is determined by the report request parameters, allowing flexible analysis across different organizational perspectives.
IHrmPlatformTimeReport.x-autobe-specification:
Computed report type aggregated from hrm_platform_timelogs with optional joins to hrm_platform_employees, hrm_platform_projects, and hrm_platform_tasks.

Query Logic:
1. GROUP BY selected dimension based on group_type: employee, project, or task
2. For employee grouping: GROUP BY hrm_platform_employee_id, JOIN hrm_platform_employees for name
3. For project grouping: GROUP BY hrm_platform_project_id, JOIN hrm_platform_projects for name
4. For task grouping: GROUP BY hrm_platform_task_id, JOIN hrm_platform_tasks for name
5. Aggregate calculations:
   - total_hours: SUM(duration) / 60.0 (convert minutes to hours)
   - billable_hours: SUM(CASE WHEN billable = true THEN duration ELSE 0 END) / 60.0
   - non_billable_hours: SUM(CASE WHEN billable = false THEN duration ELSE 0 END) / 60.0
   - entry_count: COUNT(*)
6. If weekly_summary requested: GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', date) within each group
7. Filter by organization_id (from authenticated employee), date range, and optional filters (project_id, task_id, employee_id, billable)

Join Requirements:
- hrm_platform_timelogs (source table)
- LEFT JOIN hrm_platform_employees ON timelogs.hrm_platform_employee_id = employees.id
- LEFT JOIN hrm_platform_projects ON timelogs.hrm_platform_project_id = projects.id
- LEFT JOIN hrm_platform_tasks ON timelogs.hrm_platform_task_id = tasks.id

Edge Cases:
- Empty date range returns empty array
- No matching timelogs returns empty array
- Weekly summary only included if requested in IHrmPlatformTimeReport.IRequest

id.description: Unique identifier for the timesheet record.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.id. Primary key UUID identifying the timesheet record.

employee.description: The employee who owns this timesheet.
employee.x-autobe-specification: Join via hrm_platform_employee_id FK to hrm_platform_employees. Returns IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary with employee details including employment type, status, department, and role.

approver.description: The employee who approved or rejected this timesheet. Null if not yet approved or rejected.
approver.x-autobe-specification: Join via approver_id FK to hrm_platform_employees (nullable). Returns IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary when timesheet has been approved or rejected. Null for draft or unapproved timesheets.

week_start_date.description: The Monday date marking the start of the week covered by this timesheet. The timesheet includes all time entries from Monday through Sunday.
week_start_date.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.week_start_date. DateTime representing the Monday that begins the week covered by this timesheet. The timesheet includes all timelogs from Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59:59.

status.description: Current status of the timesheet in the approval workflow. Valid values: draft, submitted, approved, or rejected.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.status. Valid values: draft (initial state, editable), submitted (awaiting approval), approved (finalized, timelogs locked), rejected (returned to draft with reason). Indicates current position in approval workflow.

total_hours.description: Total hours worked during the week, calculated by summing all time entries included in this timesheet. Displayed as decimal hours.
total_hours.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.total_hours. Decimal number representing total hours worked during the week, calculated by summing all timelog durations (in minutes) and converting to hours (e.g., 40.5 for 40 hours 30 minutes).

submitted_at.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was submitted for approval. Null if the timesheet is in draft or rejected status.
submitted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.submitted_at. DateTime when the employee submitted this timesheet for approval. Null for draft or rejected timesheets. Populated when status transitions from draft to submitted.

approved_at.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was approved by an authorized reviewer. Null if not yet approved or if rejected.
approved_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.approved_at. DateTime when an authorized reviewer approved this timesheet. Null for draft, submitted, or rejected timesheets. Populated when status transitions from submitted to approved.

rejected_at.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was rejected by an authorized reviewer. Null if not yet rejected or if approved.
rejected_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.rejected_at. DateTime when an authorized reviewer rejected this timesheet. Null for draft, submitted, or approved timesheets. Populated when status transitions from submitted to rejected.

rejection_reason.description: Reason provided by the reviewer when rejecting the timesheet. Required when rejecting, visible to the employee for corrections.
rejection_reason.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.rejection_reason. Text explanation provided by the reviewer when rejecting the timesheet. Required when rejecting. Visible to the employee for corrections. Null for draft, submitted, or approved timesheets.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was first created.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.created_at. DateTime when the timesheet record was first created in the system. Auto-generated by database.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was last modified.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.updated_at. DateTime when the timesheet record was last modified. Auto-updated by database on any changes.

IHrmPlatformTimesheet.description: Complete timesheet entity representing a weekly aggregation of time entries for an employee. Timesheets cover a full calendar week (Monday through Sunday) and progress through an approval workflow with four distinct states: draft (editable), submitted (awaiting approval), approved (finalized), and rejected (returned to draft with reason). This entity includes the employee who owns the timesheet, the approver (if applicable), the week start date, current status, total hours worked, and all approval workflow timestamps.
IHrmPlatformTimesheet.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets table. JOIN with hrm_platform_employees table twice: once for employee owner via hrm_platform_employee_id FK, once for approver via approver_id FK (nullable). Return all fields except deleted_at (soft delete filter). The status field indicates approval workflow state: draft, submitted, approved, or rejected. Total hours is calculated by summing all timelog durations for the week. Workflow timestamps (submitted_at, approved_at, rejected_at) are populated based on approval transitions. Rejection reason is required when status is rejected.

id.description: Unique identifier of the project.
id.x-autobe-specification: Project primary key selected from hrm_platform_projects.id in computed aggregation query. Unique identifier for the project in the budget report.

name.x-autobe-specification: Project name selected from hrm_platform_projects.name in computed aggregation query. Unique within organization.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the project.
status.x-autobe-specification: Project status selected from hrm_platform_projects.status in computed aggregation query. Valid values: 'active', 'completed', 'archived'.

color_code.description: Color code for visual identification of the project.
color_code.x-autobe-specification: Color code selected from hrm_platform_projects.color_code in computed aggregation query. Used for visual identification in UI.

budget_hours.description: Total budgeted hours allocated for the project.
budget_hours.x-autobe-specification: Budget hours selected from hrm_platform_projects.budget_hours in computed aggregation query. Total estimated effort in hours. Only projects with budget_hours not null are included in reports.

actual_hours.description: Total actual hours logged against the project, calculated from all time entries.
actual_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration) / 60.0 WHERE hrm_platform_timelogs.hrm_platform_project_id = project.id AND hrm_platform_timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL. Defaults to 0.0 if no timelogs exist. Date range filter may be applied based on request parameters.

budget_consumption_percentage.description: Percentage of the project budget that has been consumed (actual hours divided by budget hours).
budget_consumption_percentage.x-autobe-specification: Computed value: (actual_hours / budget_hours) * 100.0. Defaults to 0.0 if budget_hours is 0 or null. Indicates the percentage of the project budget that has been consumed.

timelog_count.description: Total number of time entries logged against the project.
timelog_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: COUNT(hrm_platform_timelogs.id) WHERE hrm_platform_timelogs.hrm_platform_project_id = project.id AND hrm_platform_timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL. Defaults to 0 if no timelogs exist. Date range filter may be applied based on request parameters.

IHrmPlatformProjectBudgetReport.ISummary.description:
Lightweight summary of project budget tracking data for administrative reporting. This type provides a consolidated view of project budget consumption by combining project metadata with aggregated time tracking metrics. Each entry shows the budgeted hours versus actual hours logged, the percentage of budget consumed, and the total number of time entries.

Used in paginated list responses for the project budget reports endpoint, this summary type enables administrators to quickly identify projects that are approaching or exceeding their allocated effort estimates. The data is computed in real-time from the underlying projects and timelogs tables, ensuring accuracy while maintaining performance through efficient aggregation queries.
IHrmPlatformProjectBudgetReport.ISummary.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_projects and hrm_platform_timelogs tables.

For each project with budget_hours not null:
1. Select project fields: id, name, status, color_code, budget_hours
2. Calculate actual_hours: SUM(timelogs.duration) / 60.0 WHERE timelogs.hrm_platform_project_id = project.id AND timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL
3. Apply date range filter to timelogs if provided in request
4. Calculate budget_consumption_percentage: (actual_hours / budget_hours) * 100.0
5. Calculate timelog_count: COUNT(timelogs.id) WHERE timelogs.hrm_platform_project_id = project.id AND timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL

Edge cases:
- actual_hours defaults to 0.0 if no timelogs exist
- budget_consumption_percentage defaults to 0.0 if budget_hours is 0 or null
- timelog_count defaults to 0 if no timelogs exist

start_date.description: Start date for filtering time entries. Only timelogs on or after this date will be included in the utilization calculation. Optional parameter.
start_date.x-autobe-specification: Filter parameter for timelog date range. When provided, only timelogs with log_date >= start_date are included in the utilization calculation. The date-time value is compared against hrm_platform_timelogs.log_date column. Optional - if omitted, no lower date bound is applied and all timelogs from the beginning of time are considered.

end_date.description: End date for filtering time entries. Only timelogs on or before this date will be included in the utilization calculation. Optional parameter.
end_date.x-autobe-specification: Filter parameter for timelog date range. When provided, only timelogs with log_date <= end_date are included in the utilization calculation. The date-time value is compared against hrm_platform_timelogs.log_date column. Optional - if omitted, no upper date bound is applied and all timelogs through the present are considered.

page.description:
Target page number to retrieve (1-indexed).

Specifies which page of results to return. Page numbering starts from 1.
If omitted, null, or undefined, defaults to page 1 (first page).
Requesting a page beyond the available range returns an empty data array
with valid pagination metadata reflecting the actual totals.
page.x-autobe-specification: 1-indexed page number. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

limit.description:
Maximum number of records to return per page.

Controls how many records are included in each page response. If omitted,
null, or undefined, defaults to 100 records per page. The server may
enforce upper bounds to prevent excessive resource consumption on large
requests.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Maximum records per page. Defaults to 100 if not provided.

IHrmPlatformProjectUtilization.IRequest.description: Optional filtering parameters for project utilization calculation. Specify a date range to calculate utilization statistics for a specific period. If no date range is provided, utilization is calculated across all time entries for the project.
IHrmPlatformProjectUtilization.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Request parameters for filtering project utilization calculation. start_date filters timelogs from this date onwards (inclusive). end_date filters timelogs up to this date (inclusive). Both parameters are optional - if omitted, all timelogs for the project are included in the utilization calculation regardless of date. Backend applies these filters when querying hrm_platform_timelogs table where project_id matches the path parameter and log_date falls within the specified range. The utilization statistics are computed by aggregating filtered timelog durations and comparing against the project's budget_hours from hrm_platform_projects table.

week_start_date.description: The Monday date marking the start of the week covered by this summary report.
week_start_date.x-autobe-specification: Computed value representing the Monday date of the week. Calculated by truncating the week's start date to remove time component. Format: YYYY-MM-DD (date, not date-time). This is the first day of the 7-day period (Monday through Sunday) covered by this weekly summary.

week_end_date.description: The Sunday date marking the end of the week covered by this summary report.
week_end_date.x-autobe-specification: Computed value representing the Sunday date of the week. Calculated as week_start_date + 6 days. Format: YYYY-MM-DD (date, not date-time). This is the last day of the 7-day period (Monday through Sunday) covered by this weekly summary.

total_hours.description: Total hours worked during the week, calculated by summing all time entries and converting from minutes to hours.
total_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SUM(timelog.duration) / 60.0. Sums all timelog durations (in minutes) for the week and converts to hours as a decimal value. Example: 40.5 represents 40 hours and 30 minutes. Only includes timelogs where deleted_at IS NULL.

timelog_count.description: The total number of time entries (timelogs) recorded during this week.
timelog_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: COUNT(timelog.id). Counts the total number of individual timelog entries recorded during the week. Only includes timelogs where deleted_at IS NULL and belong to the current organization.

employee_count.description: The number of unique employees who logged time during this week.
employee_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: COUNT(DISTINCT timelog.hrm_platform_employee_id). Counts the number of unique employees who logged at least one time entry during the week. Only includes employees from the current organization.

IWeeklySummaryReport.ISummary.description:
Lightweight weekly summary report data for list views. Represents aggregated time tracking statistics for a single calendar week (Monday to Sunday).

Each weekly summary includes the week boundaries, total hours logged across all employees, the number of time entries recorded, and the count of employees who logged time during that week. This summary type is optimized for display in paginated report lists, excluding detailed breakdowns that would be retrieved through separate endpoints.

The data is scoped to the current organization context and can be filtered by specific projects when analyzing time allocation for particular initiatives.
IWeeklySummaryReport.ISummary.x-autobe-specification:
Aggregate weekly summary data from hrm_platform_timesheets and hrm_platform_timelogs tables.

1. For each week in the requested date range (Monday to Sunday):
   - week_start_date: Calculate Monday of the week (truncate to date)
   - week_end_date: Calculate Sunday of the week (week_start_date + 6 days)

2. Join hrm_platform_timesheets with hrm_platform_timelogs:
   - Filter by organization_id (current organization context from JWT)
   - Filter by week boundaries (timelog.date between week_start_date and week_end_date)
   - Optional: Filter by project_id if provided in request parameters
   - Exclude soft-deleted timelogs (deleted_at IS NULL)

3. Aggregate per week:
   - total_hours: SUM(timelog.duration) / 60.0 (convert minutes to hours)
   - timelog_count: COUNT(timelog.id)
   - employee_count: COUNT(DISTINCT timelog.hrm_platform_employee_id)

4. Handle edge cases:
   - If no timelogs for a week, return zero values for aggregates
   - Ensure consistent timezone handling based on organization settings
   - Format dates as YYYY-MM-DD (date format, not date-time)

5. Sort results by week_start_date descending (most recent week first)

actual_hours.description: Total actual hours logged on the project, calculated from all time entries. Represents the sum of all work duration recorded by employees for this project, converted from minutes to hours.
actual_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed by aggregating hrm_platform_timelogs.duration field. Query all timelogs for the project (filtered by project_id and optional date range), sum the duration values (in minutes), then divide by 60 to convert to hours. Returns 0 if no timelogs exist for the project.

budget_hours.description: The project's budgeted hours as defined in the project settings. This is the planned or estimated total effort for the project. If null, the project has no budget defined and utilization percentage cannot be calculated.
budget_hours.x-autobe-specification: Retrieved directly from hrm_platform_projects.budget_hours column for the target project. This is a nullable field - if the project has no budget defined, this returns null. When null, utilization_percentage will also be null since there is no baseline for comparison.

utilization_percentage.description: Percentage of the project budget that has been consumed by actual time logged. A value of 80 means 80% of the budget has been used. Values exceeding 100 indicate the project has exceeded its budget. Returns null if no budget is defined for the project.
utilization_percentage.x-autobe-specification: Computed as (actual_hours / budget_hours) * 100. Returns null if budget_hours is null (no budget defined). The value can exceed 100 if the project has exceeded its budget (overutilization). Maximum value of 10000 allows for extreme overbudget scenarios (10000% utilization). This metric is essential for identifying projects at risk of budget overrun.

billable_hours.description: Total hours logged on the project that are marked as billable to clients. This represents chargeable work time that can be invoiced to customers. Calculated from timelogs where the billable flag is true.
billable_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed by aggregating hrm_platform_timelogs.duration where billable=true. Query all timelogs for the project, filter to only those with billable=true, sum their duration values (in minutes), then divide by 60 to convert to hours. Returns 0 if no billable timelogs exist.

non_billable_hours.description: Total hours logged on the project that are marked as non-billable. This represents internal work time that cannot be charged to clients, such as administrative tasks, training, or internal development. Calculated from timelogs where the billable flag is false.
non_billable_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed by aggregating hrm_platform_timelogs.duration where billable=false. Query all timelogs for the project, filter to only those with billable=false, sum their duration values (in minutes), then divide by 60 to convert to hours. Returns 0 if no non-billable timelogs exist.

total_timelog_count.description: Total number of individual time entries (timelogs) recorded for the project. This provides insight into the granularity of time tracking - a higher count indicates more detailed daily time logging versus fewer consolidated entries.
total_timelog_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed by counting all timelog records for the project. Query hrm_platform_timelogs filtered by project_id and optional date range, then count the total number of records. Returns 0 if no timelogs exist for the project.

IHrmPlatformProjectUtilization.description: Project utilization statistics comparing actual time logged against the project's budget hours. Provides key performance indicators for project management and budget tracking including total hours consumed, budget utilization percentage, and billable versus non-billable time breakdown. The utilization percentage indicates budget consumption - projects exceeding 80% can be flagged for review. Use this endpoint to monitor project progress and prevent budget overruns.
IHrmPlatformProjectUtilization.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation DTO that combines data from hrm_platform_timelogs and hrm_platform_projects tables. Query timelogs filtered by project_id from path parameter and optional date range from request body. Calculate actual_hours as SUM(duration) / 60 from all matching timelogs. Retrieve budget_hours directly from hrm_platform_projects.budget_hours column (nullable). Calculate utilization_percentage as (actual_hours / budget_hours) * 100, returning null if budget_hours is null. Calculate billable_hours as SUM(duration WHERE billable=true) / 60. Calculate non_billable_hours as SUM(duration WHERE billable=false) / 60. Count total_timelog_count as COUNT of all matching timelogs. All calculations scoped to authenticated user's organization for data isolation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the timesheet record.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.id. Primary key, UUID format.

week_start_date.description: Monday date marking the start of the week covered by this timesheet. The timesheet covers Monday through Sunday of this week.
week_start_date.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.week_start_date. DateTime field representing Monday of the week covered by this timesheet (Monday through Sunday).

status.description: Current status of the timesheet in the approval workflow. Valid values: draft, submitted, approved, rejected.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.status. String field with values: draft (initial state, editable), submitted (awaiting approval), approved (finalized, timelogs locked), rejected (returned to draft with reason).

total_hours.description: Total hours worked during the week, calculated by summing all timelog durations included in this timesheet. Displayed as decimal hours (e.g., 40.5 for 40 hours 30 minutes).
total_hours.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.total_hours. Float field representing the sum of all timelog durations included in this timesheet, displayed as decimal hours.

employee.description: The employee who owns this timesheet. Contains employee summary information including employment type, status, member identity, department, and role.
employee.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.employee via JOIN on hrm_platform_employee_id to hrm_platform_employees. Returns IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary object with employee details.

approver.description: The employee who approved or rejected this timesheet. Null for draft or submitted timesheets that have not yet been reviewed.
approver.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.approver via LEFT JOIN on approver_id to hrm_platform_employees. Returns nullable IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary object. Null when timesheet is in draft status or has not been approved/rejected yet.

submitted_at.description: Timestamp when the employee submitted this timesheet for approval. Null for draft or rejected timesheets.
submitted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.submitted_at. Nullable DateTime field. Populated when employee submits the timesheet for approval. Null for draft or rejected timesheets.

approved_at.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was approved by an authorized reviewer. Null for draft, submitted, or rejected timesheets.
approved_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.approved_at. Nullable DateTime field. Populated when an authorized reviewer approves the timesheet. Null for draft, submitted, or rejected timesheets.

rejected_at.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was rejected by an authorized reviewer. Null for draft, submitted, or approved timesheets.
rejected_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.rejected_at. Nullable DateTime field. Populated when an authorized reviewer rejects the timesheet. Null for draft, submitted, or approved timesheets.

rejection_reason.description: Reason provided by the reviewer when rejecting the timesheet. Required when rejecting. Visible to the employee for corrections.
rejection_reason.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.rejection_reason. Nullable String field. Required when rejecting a timesheet. Visible to the employee for corrections.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this timesheet was first created.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.created_at. DateTime field representing when the timesheet was first created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this timesheet was last modified.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets.updated_at. DateTime field representing when the timesheet was last modified.

IHrmPlatformTimesheet.ISummary.description: Lightweight timesheet summary for list views. Represents a weekly timesheet aggregation covering Monday through Sunday, showing essential information such as week date, approval status, total hours worked, and employee details. Includes approval workflow information (submitted, approved, rejected timestamps and approver) when applicable. Used in paginated timesheet listings for both member and admin views.
IHrmPlatformTimesheet.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_timesheets table. Fields: id, week_start_date, status, total_hours, created_at, updated_at map directly. employee relation: JOIN hrm_platform_employees on hrm_platform_employee_id, return as IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary. approver relation: LEFT JOIN hrm_platform_employees on approver_id, return as nullable IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary. Timestamps submitted_at, approved_at, rejected_at, rejection_reason are nullable based on approval workflow state. Excluded: deleted_at (soft delete not shown in active lists), snapshots (HAS-MANY composition accessed via separate endpoint), FK columns exposed as relation objects.

IHrmPlatformActivityLog.description: Complete activity log entry representing an immutable audit trail record of a business action within the organization. Includes the action type, affected entity, acting user information, and detailed field-level changes for compliance and traceability purposes.
IHrmPlatformActivityLog.x-autobe-specification: Direct field mapping from hrm_platform_activity_logs table. JOIN with hrm_platform_organizations on hrm_platform_organization_id for organization object. LEFT JOIN with hrm_platform_members on hrm_platform_member_id for actingMember (nullable). INNER JOIN with hrm_platform_activity_log_changes on activity_log_id for changes array, ordered by created_at. Return complete nested structure.

startDate.description: Start date for filtering timelogs in the budget report. Only timelogs on or after this date will be included in the budget calculation.
startDate.x-autobe-specification: Optional start date filter for budget report. When provided, filters hrm_platform_timelogs by log_date >= startDate. Backend applies this as a WHERE clause condition on the timelog query. If not provided, no start date filtering is applied and all timelogs from the beginning are included.

endDate.description: End date for filtering timelogs in the budget report. Only timelogs on or before this date will be included in the budget calculation.
endDate.x-autobe-specification: Optional end date filter for budget report. When provided, filters hrm_platform_timelogs by log_date <= endDate. Backend applies this as a WHERE clause condition on the timelog query. If not provided, no end date filtering is applied and all timelogs through the present are included.

IHrmPlatformProject.IBudgetReportRequest.description: Optional filter parameters for generating a project budget consumption report. Use date range filters to analyze budget consumption over specific periods. All fields are optional - omitting them returns the report for all time.
IHrmPlatformProject.IBudgetReportRequest.x-autobe-specification: Request body for filtering project budget consumption reports. startDate and endDate are optional date range filters applied to hrm_platform_timelogs.log_date field when querying time entries for budget calculation. Backend implementation: 1) If startDate is provided, filter timelogs WHERE log_date >= startDate, 2) If endDate is provided, filter timelogs WHERE log_date <= endDate, 3) If both provided, validate startDate <= endDate and return error if invalid, 4) If neither provided, include all timelogs regardless of date. The filtered timelogs are then aggregated (SUM(duration)/60) to calculate actual_hours for the budget report.

start_date.description: Start date of the report period in ISO date format (YYYY-MM-DD). Defines the beginning boundary for weekly summary aggregation.
start_date.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter defining the beginning of the report period. ISO date format (YYYY-MM-DD). Used to calculate the first calendar week (Monday-Sunday) to include in the aggregated results. Must be before or equal to end_date.

end_date.description: End date of the report period in ISO date format (YYYY-MM-DD). Defines the ending boundary for weekly summary aggregation.
end_date.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter defining the end of the report period. ISO date format (YYYY-MM-DD). Used to calculate the last calendar week (Monday-Sunday) to include in the aggregated results. Must be after or equal to start_date.

project_id.description: Optional project filter UUID. When provided, limits the weekly summary to show only time tracking data for the specified project.
project_id.x-autobe-specification: Optional filter parameter to scope the weekly summary report to a specific project. UUID format. When provided, the aggregation JOINs with hrm_platform_timelogs to filter by this project_id, showing only time entries for that project across all weeks in the date range.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-indexed). Defaults to 1 if not specified.
page.x-autobe-specification: Pagination page number for the weekly summary results. Integer, minimum value 1 (1-indexed). Used to calculate the offset when querying aggregated weekly data. Default is 1 if not provided.

limit.description: Number of weekly summary records per page. Minimum 1, maximum 100.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Maximum number of weekly summary records to return per page. Integer, minimum 1, maximum 100. Controls the page size for paginated results. Default is typically 20 if not provided.

IWeeklySummaryReport.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for retrieving weekly summary reports. This report aggregates time tracking data organized by calendar week, showing total hours logged, number of time entries, and employee participation for each week within the specified date range.

Required parameters include the date range (start_date and end_date) defining the report period. Optional parameters allow filtering by specific project and pagination control.

The report covers complete calendar weeks from Monday to Sunday, providing insights into work patterns and productivity trends over time. Results are sorted with the most recent week first.
IWeeklySummaryReport.IRequest.x-autobe-specification:
This is a computed request type for weekly summary report queries. No direct database mapping.

Query parameters:
- start_date: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) - beginning of report period
- end_date: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) - end of report period
- project_id: UUID - optional filter to scope report to specific project
- page: integer (minimum 1) - pagination page number
- limit: integer (minimum 1, maximum 100) - items per page

Validation:
- start_date must be before or equal to end_date
- Both dates must be valid ISO date format
- Date range should be reasonable (e.g., not exceeding 2 years)

Backend processing:
- Calculate all calendar weeks (Monday-Sunday) within the date range
- For each week, aggregate from hrm_platform_timesheets and hrm_platform_timelogs
- Apply project_id filter if provided via JOIN with hrm_platform_timelogs
- Return paginated weekly summary results sorted by week_start_date descending

totalEmployees.description: Total number of active employees in the organization.
totalEmployees.x-autobe-specification: Computed count: COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_employees WHERE organization_id = {current_org_id} AND status = 'active'. Aggregates all active employees in the organization.

employeesByType.description: Breakdown of employee counts by employment type (full-time, part-time, contractor, intern).
employeesByType.x-autobe-specification: Computed object: GROUP BY employment_type from hrm_platform_employees WHERE organization_id = {current_org_id} AND status = 'active'. Returns counts for full-time, part-time, contractor, and intern employment types.

employeesByDepartment.description: Breakdown of employee counts by department within the organization.
employeesByDepartment.x-autobe-specification: Computed array: JOIN hrm_platform_employees with hrm_platform_departments ON department_id, GROUP BY department_id WHERE organization_id = {current_org_id} AND status = 'active'. Returns array of objects with department name and employee count.

totalHoursLogged.description: Total hours logged across all employees and projects within the specified date range.
totalHoursLogged.x-autobe-specification: Computed sum: SUM(duration_hours) from hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM hrm_platform_employees WHERE organization_id = {current_org_id}) AND date >= {start_date} AND date <= {end_date}. Applies date range filters from request.

averageHoursPerEmployee.description: Average hours logged per employee during the specified period.
averageHoursPerEmployee.x-autobe-specification: Computed division: totalHoursLogged / totalEmployees. Returns 0 if totalEmployees is 0 to prevent division by zero error. Represents average hours worked per employee in the period.

activeTimers.description: Number of currently active timer sessions across all employees in the organization.
activeTimers.x-autobe-specification: Computed count: COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_timers WHERE employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM hrm_platform_employees WHERE organization_id = {current_org_id}) AND status = 'running'. Returns number of currently active time tracking sessions.

timesheetsByStatus.description: Breakdown of timesheet counts by status (draft, submitted, approved, rejected).
timesheetsByStatus.x-autobe-specification: Computed object: GROUP BY status from hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM hrm_platform_employees WHERE organization_id = {current_org_id}). Returns counts for draft, submitted, approved, and rejected timesheet statuses.

pendingApprovals.description: Number of timesheets awaiting manager approval (status = submitted).
pendingApprovals.x-autobe-specification: Computed count: COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM hrm_platform_employees WHERE organization_id = {current_org_id}) AND status = 'submitted'. Subset of timesheetsByStatus.submitted.

projectsByStatus.description: Breakdown of project counts by status (active, completed, archived).
projectsByStatus.x-autobe-specification: Computed object: GROUP BY status from hrm_platform_projects WHERE organization_id = {current_org_id}. Returns counts for active, completed, and archived project statuses.

budgetWarnings.description: List of projects that have exceeded their allocated budget hours, showing project details and overage information.
budgetWarnings.x-autobe-specification: Computed array: JOIN hrm_platform_projects with hrm_platform_timelogs ON project_id WHERE organization_id = {current_org_id} AND budget_hours IS NOT NULL. GROUP BY project_id, calculate SUM(duration_hours) as actual_hours, filter WHERE actual_hours > budget_hours. Returns array of project warnings with project name, budget hours, actual hours, and overage percentage.

topPerformers.description: Top 5 employees ranked by total hours logged during the specified period, showing employee name and hours worked.
topPerformers.x-autobe-specification: Computed array: SELECT employee_id, SUM(duration_hours) as total_hours FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM hrm_platform_employees WHERE organization_id = {current_org_id}) AND date >= {start_date} AND date <= {end_date} GROUP BY employee_id ORDER BY total_hours DESC LIMIT 5. JOIN with hrm_platform_employees to get employee name and details.

IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.description:
Comprehensive organization dashboard metrics providing a consolidated view of organizational performance. This response includes employee statistics broken down by employment type and department, time tracking metrics including total hours logged and active timers, timesheet approval status, project health indicators with budget warnings, and a ranking of top performers by hours logged.

The dashboard is designed for administrative users (organization owners and managers) to monitor overall organizational health, identify areas requiring attention such as pending timesheet approvals or budget overruns, and recognize high-performing employees. All metrics are scoped to the current organization context and can be filtered by date range.

Use this dashboard to get a quick overview of organizational performance without needing to query individual entities separately.
IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboard.x-autobe-specification:
Aggregate data from multiple tables to compute organization dashboard metrics:

1. Employee Statistics:
   - totalEmployees: COUNT from hrm_platform_employees WHERE organization_id = {current} AND status = 'active'
   - employeesByType: GROUP BY employment_type (full-time, part-time, contractor, intern)
   - employeesByDepartment: JOIN hrm_platform_departments, GROUP BY department_id, include department name

2. Time Tracking Statistics:
   - totalHoursLogged: SUM(duration_hours) from hrm_platform_timelogs for date range
   - averageHoursPerEmployee: totalHoursLogged / totalEmployees (handle divide by zero)
   - activeTimers: COUNT from hrm_platform_timers WHERE organization_id = {current}

3. Timesheet Statistics:
   - timesheetsByStatus: COUNT GROUP BY status (draft, submitted, approved, rejected)
   - pendingApprovals: COUNT WHERE status = 'submitted'

4. Project Statistics:
   - projectsByStatus: COUNT GROUP BY status (active, completed, archived)
   - budgetWarnings: JOIN timelogs on project, compare SUM(hours) vs budget_hours, filter where exceeded

5. Top Performers:
   - GROUP BY employee_id from hrm_platform_timelogs
   - SUM hours, ORDER BY DESC, LIMIT 5
   - JOIN hrm_platform_employees for employee details

All queries scoped to current organization from auth context. Apply date range filters from request body if provided.

departments.description: Array of top-level departments, each containing their direct child departments in a hierarchical structure.
departments.x-autobe-specification:
Computed hierarchical structure from hrm_platform_departments table.

1. Query all non-deleted departments for current organization
2. Separate into top-level (parent_id IS NULL) and child departments (parent_id IS NOT NULL)
3. For each top-level department, find matching child departments where parent_id = top-level id
4. Structure as array of ITopLevel objects with nested childDepartments arrays
5. Sort by name at each level
6. Return only one level of nesting (top-level + direct children)

IHrmPlatformDepartment.IHierarchy.description:
Hierarchical structure of departments within an organization.

This type represents the complete department hierarchy organized as a tree structure. The root array contains top-level departments (those without a parent), and each top-level department includes a childDepartments array containing its direct child departments.

The hierarchy is limited to one level of nesting - top-level departments and their direct children only. Child departments cannot have their own child departments, enforcing the system's one-level nesting constraint.

Each department includes its unique identifier, name, optional description, and timestamps. This structure enables efficient rendering of organizational charts and department navigation in user interfaces.
IHrmPlatformDepartment.IHierarchy.x-autobe-specification:
Query hrm_platform_departments table for the current organization and structure into hierarchical tree.

1. Filter by organization_id from authenticated user's organization context
2. Exclude soft-deleted departments (deleted_at IS NULL)
3. Query top-level departments (parent_id IS NULL) as root array elements
4. For each top-level department, query child departments where parent_id equals the top-level department's id
5. Structure response as array of ITopLevel objects, each containing:
   - Department fields (id, name, description, created_at, updated_at)
   - childDepartments array with direct child departments
6. Sort departments by name at each hierarchy level
7. Enforce one-level nesting constraint - childDepartments cannot have their own children
8. Enforce organization isolation - only return departments for the authenticated user's current organization

hoursThisWeek.description: Total hours logged by the employee during the current calendar week (Monday through Sunday). Calculated by summing all timelog durations within the week and converting from minutes to hours.
hoursThisWeek.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs: SUM(duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND date >= current week Monday AND date <= current week Sunday, then divide by 60 to convert minutes to hours. Returns 0 if no timelogs exist for this week.

hoursThisMonth.description: Total hours logged by the employee during the current calendar month. Calculated by summing all timelog durations within the month and converting from minutes to hours.
hoursThisMonth.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs: SUM(duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND date >= first day of current month AND date <= last day of current month, then divide by 60 to convert minutes to hours. Returns 0 if no timelogs exist this month.

hoursAllTime.description: Total hours logged by the employee across all time periods. Cumulative sum of all timelog durations converted from minutes to hours.
hoursAllTime.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs: SUM(duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id = {employeeId}, then divide by 60 to convert minutes to hours. Returns 0 if no timelogs exist for this employee.

activeTimer.description: Indicates whether the employee currently has an active (running) timer session. True if a timer exists with stopped_at set to null, false if no active timer is running.
activeTimer.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timers: EXISTS WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND stopped_at IS NULL. Returns true if an active (running) timer exists for this employee, false otherwise.

activeTimerProjectId.description: The project identifier associated with the employee's active timer session. Null if the employee has no active timer running. References a project in hrm_platform_projects.
activeTimerProjectId.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timers: SELECT project_id WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND stopped_at IS NULL. Returns the project_id of the active timer, or null if no active timer exists. Maps to hrm_platform_projects.id.

activeTimerTaskId.description: The task identifier associated with the employee's active timer session. Null if the employee has no active timer or if the timer is not linked to a specific task. References a task in hrm_platform_tasks.
activeTimerTaskId.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timers: SELECT task_id WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND stopped_at IS NULL. Returns the task_id of the active timer, or null if no active timer exists or the timer is not associated with a specific task. Maps to hrm_platform_tasks.id.

activeTimerStartedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the employee's active timer session was started. Null if no active timer is running. Format follows ISO 8601 date-time standard.
activeTimerStartedAt.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timers: SELECT started_at WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND stopped_at IS NULL. Returns the timestamp when the active timer was started, or null if no active timer exists. Format: ISO 8601 date-time string.

assignedTasksCount.description: The number of tasks currently assigned to the employee that have not been completed. Excludes tasks with 'completed' status. Used to track pending work load.
assignedTasksCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_tasks: COUNT(*) WHERE assigned_employee_id = {employeeId} AND status != 'completed'. Returns the number of tasks assigned to this employee that have not been completed. Only counts tasks with status other than 'completed'.

pendingTimesheetsCount.description: The number of timesheets submitted by the employee that are currently awaiting approval. Only counts timesheets with 'submitted' status, indicating they need manager review.
pendingTimesheetsCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timesheets: COUNT(*) WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND status = 'submitted'. Returns the number of timesheets that have been submitted by this employee but not yet approved or rejected.

billableHours.description: Total billable hours logged by the employee across all time. Sum of all timelog durations marked as billable, converted from minutes to hours. Used for client billing and revenue tracking.
billableHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs: SUM(duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND billable = true, then divide by 60 to convert minutes to hours. Returns 0 if no billable timelogs exist.

nonBillableHours.description: Total non-billable hours logged by the employee across all time. Sum of all timelog durations marked as non-billable, converted from minutes to hours. Used for internal work tracking and capacity planning.
nonBillableHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs: SUM(duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND billable = false, then divide by 60 to convert minutes to hours. Returns 0 if no non-billable timelogs exist.

hoursByProject.description: Breakdown of hours logged by the employee grouped by project. Each entry includes the project identifier, name, code, and total hours logged for that project. Sorted by hours in descending order.
hoursByProject.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs: GROUP BY project_id WHERE employee_id = {employeeId}, SUM(duration_minutes) per project divided by 60. JOIN with hrm_platform_projects to get project name and code. Returns array of IHrmPlatformEmployee.IWorkloadProjectHour objects with project_id, project_name, project_code, and hours_logged fields.

IHrmPlatformEmployee.IWorkload.description: Comprehensive workload statistics for an employee, aggregating time tracking data and task assignments across multiple time periods. This computed response type provides managers and administrators with insights into employee work patterns, current workload status, and time distribution. Includes hours worked this week, this month, and all-time totals, active timer status with project/task details, count of assigned tasks and pending timesheets, billable versus non-billable hour breakdown, and a project-by-project hours distribution. Used in workload dashboards, employee performance metrics, and capacity planning interfaces.
IHrmPlatformEmployee.IWorkload.x-autobe-specification:
Compute workload statistics by aggregating data from multiple tables:

1. hoursThisWeek: SUM(duration_minutes) from hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND date >= start of current week (Monday) AND date <= end of current week (Sunday), divide by 60 to convert to hours
2. hoursThisMonth: SUM(duration_minutes) from hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND date >= first day of current calendar month AND date <= last day of current month, divide by 60
3. hoursAllTime: SUM(duration_minutes) from hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id = {employeeId}, divide by 60
4. activeTimer: EXISTS record in hrm_platform_timers WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND stopped_at IS NULL
5. activeTimerProjectId: SELECT project_id from hrm_platform_timers WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND stopped_at IS NULL (nullable)
6. activeTimerTaskId: SELECT task_id from hrm_platform_timers WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND stopped_at IS NULL (nullable)
7. activeTimerStartedAt: SELECT started_at from hrm_platform_timers WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND stopped_at IS NULL (nullable)
8. assignedTasksCount: COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_tasks WHERE assigned_employee_id = {employeeId} AND status != 'completed'
9. pendingTimesheetsCount: COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND status = 'submitted'
10. billableHours: SUM(duration_minutes) from hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND billable = true, divide by 60
11. nonBillableHours: SUM(duration_minutes) from hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} AND billable = false, divide by 60
12. hoursByProject: GROUP BY project_id from hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id = {employeeId}, SUM(duration_minutes) per project divided by 60, join with hrm_platform_projects to get project name and code

Validation:
- Return 404 if employee not found or belongs to different organization
- Return 403 if requester lacks permission to view this employee's data
- Handle NULL values for optional timer fields gracefully
- Return 0 for hours when no timelogs exist

name.x-autobe-specification: Retrieved from hrm_platform_projects.name. Required field that uniquely identifies the project within the organization.

description.description: Optional description of the project.
