status.description: Current lifecycle status of the project.
status.x-autobe-specification: Retrieved from hrm_platform_projects.status. Valid values: 'active' (work in progress), 'completed' (work finished), 'archived' (historical reference).

color_code.description: Color code for visual identification of the project.
color_code.x-autobe-specification: Retrieved from hrm_platform_projects.color_code. Required field for visual distinction in user interfaces.

organization.description: The organization to which this project belongs.
organization.x-autobe-specification: Retrieved via JOIN from hrm_platform_projects.organization_id to hrm_platform_organizations. Returns IHrmPlatformOrganization.ISummary with organization details including settings and logo.

budget_hours.description: Total estimated budget hours for the project. Null if no budget is defined.
budget_hours.x-autobe-specification: Retrieved from hrm_platform_projects.budget_hours. Nullable field representing total estimated effort in hours for the project. Used as baseline for budget calculations.

actual_hours.description: Total hours actually logged against this project, calculated from all associated timelogs.
actual_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed by aggregating hrm_platform_timelogs: SUM(duration) / 60.0 where hrm_platform_project_id = projectId AND deleted_at IS NULL. Optional date range filters applied from request body. Returns 0 if no timelogs exist.

remaining_hours.description: Remaining budget hours (budget_hours minus actual_hours). Null if no budget is defined.
remaining_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as budget_hours - actual_hours. Returns null if budget_hours is null (no budget defined). Can be negative if project is over budget.

consumption_percentage.description: Percentage of budget consumed (actual_hours divided by budget_hours, multiplied by 100). Null if no budget is defined.
consumption_percentage.x-autobe-specification: Computed as (actual_hours / budget_hours) * 100. Returns null if budget_hours is null. Can exceed 100% if project is over budget.

is_over_budget.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the project has exceeded its budget. Null if no budget is defined.
is_over_budget.x-autobe-specification: Computed as actual_hours > budget_hours. Returns null if budget_hours is null. True when actual hours exceed the defined budget.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the project was created.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Retrieved from hrm_platform_projects.created_at. ISO 8601 datetime format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the project was last updated.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Retrieved from hrm_platform_projects.updated_at. ISO 8601 datetime format.

IHrmPlatformProject.IBudgetReport.description:
Budget consumption report for a project showing planned versus actual time expenditures.

This report provides comprehensive budget tracking information for projects with defined budget hours. It displays the total hours logged against the project's budget, the percentage of budget consumed, remaining budget hours, and whether the project is over budget.

Projects without defined budget hours will have null values for budget-related calculated fields (remaining_hours, consumption_percentage, is_over_budget), but will still show actual_hours logged.

The report can be filtered by date range to analyze budget consumption over specific periods. Use the IHrmPlatformProject.IBudgetReportRequest type to specify date range filters when making the API call.
IHrmPlatformProject.IBudgetReport.x-autobe-specification:
Compute budget report by:

1. Query hrm_platform_projects table:
   - Filter by id = projectId (from path parameter)
   - Filter by organization_id = current user's organization context
   - Filter by deleted_at IS NULL
   - Select: id, name, description, status, color_code, budget_hours, created_at, updated_at

2. Query hrm_platform_timelogs table:
   - Filter by hrm_platform_project_id = projectId
   - Filter by deleted_at IS NULL
   - Apply optional date range filters from request body (start_date, end_date)
   - Aggregate: SUM(duration) as total_minutes

3. Calculate metrics:
   - actual_hours = total_minutes / 60.0
   - budget_hours = project.budget_hours (may be null)
   - If budget_hours IS NOT NULL:
     - remaining_hours = budget_hours - actual_hours
     - consumption_percentage = (actual_hours / budget_hours) * 100
     - is_over_budget = actual_hours > budget_hours
   - If budget_hours IS NULL:
     - remaining_hours = null
     - consumption_percentage = null
     - is_over_budget = null

4. Return complete budget report object with all fields

IHrmPlatformTimesheetSnapshot.IRequest.description: Query parameters for filtering and paginating timesheet snapshots. Supports filtering by employee, approver, status, week date range, and submission/approval/rejection timestamps. All fields are optional to enable flexible search combinations.
IHrmPlatformTimesheetSnapshot.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Pagination: page, limit, cursor. Filters: employee_id (hrm_platform_employee_id), approver_id, status, week_start_date range (from/to), submitted_at range, approved_at range, rejected_at range. All fields optional for flexible querying.

total_count.description: Total number of employee invitations in the organization, excluding soft-deleted invitations.
total_count.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) of all active invitations from hrm_platform_employee_invitations where organization_id matches current context AND deleted_at IS NULL.

pending_count.description: Number of invitations currently awaiting acceptance by invitees.
pending_count.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_employee_invitations WHERE status = 'pending' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND organization_id matches current context.

accepted_count.description: Number of invitations that have been successfully accepted and redeemed by invitees.
accepted_count.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_employee_invitations WHERE status = 'accepted' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND organization_id matches current context.

expired_count.description: Number of invitations that have expired past their validity period without acceptance.
expired_count.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_employee_invitations WHERE status = 'expired' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND organization_id matches current context.

revoked_count.description: Number of invitations that were manually revoked before acceptance.
revoked_count.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_employee_invitations WHERE status = 'revoked' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND organization_id matches current context.

trend_7_days.description: Number of invitations created in the last 7 days, indicating recent invitation activity.
trend_7_days.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_employee_invitations WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND organization_id matches current context.

trend_14_days.description: Number of invitations created in the last 14 days, showing medium-term invitation trends.
trend_14_days.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_employee_invitations WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND organization_id matches current context.

trend_30_days.description: Number of invitations created in the last 30 days, providing long-term invitation activity overview.
trend_30_days.x-autobe-specification: COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_employee_invitations WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND organization_id matches current context.

by_role.description: Breakdown of invitation counts grouped by the assigned role, showing how many invitations were sent for each role type in the organization.
by_role.x-autobe-specification: GROUP BY hrm_platform_role_id from hrm_platform_employee_invitations WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND organization_id matches current context. JOIN with hrm_platform_roles on hrm_platform_role_id = roles.id to retrieve role name. COUNT(*) per role to get invitation distribution by assigned role. Return as array of IInvitationStatisticByRole objects.

IInvitationStatistic.description: Aggregated employee invitation statistics for the current organization, providing comprehensive metrics on invitation counts, status distribution (pending, accepted, expired, revoked), recent invitation trends over 7, 14, and 30-day periods, and role-based breakdowns. All statistics exclude soft-deleted invitations and are scoped to the authenticated organization context.
IInvitationStatistic.x-autobe-specification: Aggregate statistics from hrm_platform_employee_invitations table filtered by current organization_id and excluding soft-deleted invitations (deleted_at IS NULL). Calculate total_count as COUNT(*) of all active invitations. Calculate status-based counts using WHERE status = 'pending'/'accepted'/'expired'/'revoked'. Calculate time-based trends using WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7/14/30 days'. Calculate by_role breakdown using GROUP BY hrm_platform_role_id with JOIN to hrm_platform_roles for role names. Return as single statistics object without pagination.

project.description: The project for which team activity statistics are being reported. Contains essential project identification information including name, status, and visual color code.
project.x-autobe-specification: Reference to IHrmPlatformProject.ISummary containing project details (id, name, status, color_code, budget_hours, created_at) from hrm_platform_projects table. Retrieved via JOIN on project.id from the team activity aggregation query.

overall.description: Overall project-level team activity metrics including total hours logged by the entire team, total number of time entries, count of active team members, average hours per team member, and count of recent activity within the last 7 days.
overall.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation object containing project-level summary statistics:
- totalHoursLogged: SUM of all team members' duration (minutes) / 60, aggregated from hrm_platform_timelogs
- totalTimelogs: COUNT of all timelog records across all team members
- activeTeamMembersCount: COUNT of hrm_platform_project_memberships where deleted_at IS NULL
- averageHoursPerMember: totalHoursLogged / activeTeamMembersCount (returns 0 if no active members)
- recentActivityCount: COUNT of timelogs where date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'

All calculations filter out soft-deleted records (deleted_at IS NULL).

teamMembers.description: Detailed breakdown of time tracking activity for each team member assigned to the project. Each entry includes the member's employee information, total hours logged, number of time entries, average daily hours, and date of most recent activity. Team members with no time entries are included with zero values.
teamMembers.x-autobe-specification:
Array of IHrmPlatformProjectTeamActivityMember objects, one per active team member. Each member object computed by:
1. JOIN hrm_platform_project_memberships on project.id = memberships.hrm_platform_project_id WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
2. JOIN hrm_platform_employees on memberships.hrm_platform_employee_id = employees.id
3. For each employee, aggregate from hrm_platform_timelogs:
   - totalHoursLogged: SUM(duration) / 60
   - totalTimelogs: COUNT(*)
   - averageDailyHours: AVG(duration / 60) / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(date))
   - lastActivityDate: MAX(date)

Include team members even if they have no timelogs (return 0 for all metrics).

mostActiveMember.description: The team member who has logged the most hours on this project, or null if no team members have logged any time. This provides a quick reference to identify the most active contributor without parsing the complete team members list.
mostActiveMember.x-autobe-specification:
Computed reference to IHrmPlatformProjectMostActiveMember representing the team member with the highest totalHoursLogged value from the teamMembers array. Determined by:
1. Calculate totalHoursLogged for each team member (as specified in teamMembers)
2. Sort teamMembers by totalHoursLogged descending
3. Select the first member (highest hours)
4. Return null if teamMembers array is empty or all members have 0 hours

This provides quick identification of the top contributor without requiring clients to parse the full teamMembers array.

IHrmPlatformProjectTeamActivity.description: Aggregated team activity statistics for a project, providing comprehensive insights into time tracking contributions from all assigned team members. This response includes overall project-level metrics such as total hours logged, timelog counts, and team size, along with detailed per-member breakdowns showing individual contributions, activity frequency, and recent work. The data helps project leads and managers understand work distribution, identify active contributors, and assess team productivity. Statistics are calculated from all time entries associated with the project, filtered to exclude soft-deleted records, and include both historical and recent activity (last 7 days) summaries.
IHrmPlatformProjectTeamActivity.x-autobe-specification:
Aggregate team activity data from multiple tables:

1. Query hrm_platform_projects to get project details (id, name, status, color_code)

2. JOIN hrm_platform_project_memberships on project.id = memberships.hrm_platform_project_id, filtering deleted_at IS NULL to get active team members

3. For each team member, JOIN hrm_platform_employees on memberships.hrm_platform_employee_id = employees.id to get employee details

4. For each team member, aggregate from hrm_platform_timelogs:
   - SUM(duration) / 60 = total hours logged (convert minutes to hours)
   - COUNT(*) = total timelogs
   - AVG(duration / 60) / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(date)) = average daily hours
   - MAX(date) = last activity date
   - Filter: timelogs.hrm_platform_employee_id = employee.id AND timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL

5. Calculate overall statistics:
   - totalHoursLogged: SUM of all team members' hours
   - totalTimelogs: SUM of all team members' timelog counts
   - activeTeamMembersCount: COUNT of memberships where deleted_at IS NULL
   - averageHoursPerMember: totalHoursLogged / activeTeamMembersCount (0 if no members)
   - recentActivityCount: COUNT of timelogs where date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'

6. Identify mostActiveMember: team member with highest totalHoursLogged

Edge cases:
- No team members: return empty teamMembers array, zero totals
- Team members with no timelogs: include with 0 hours, 0 timelogs
- Project not found: return 404
- No permission: return 403

permission_code.description: Permission identifier to grant to the role. Must be one of the predefined permission codes that define specific capabilities such as organization management, employee management, project management, time tracking, or report viewing.
permission_code.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_role_permissions.permission_code column. Validates against allowed permission codes: 'org:manage', 'employee:manage', 'employee:view', 'project:manage', 'project:view', 'time:manage', 'time:approve', 'time:view_all', 'report:view'. Part of unique constraint with hrm_platform_role_id to prevent duplicate assignments.

IHrmPlatformRolePermission.ICreate.description: Request body for adding a permission to a role. Specifies which permission code to grant to the role identified in the path parameter. When added, all employees assigned to this role immediately gain the corresponding capability.
IHrmPlatformRolePermission.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Maps permission_code from request body to hrm_platform_role_permissions.permission_code column. The hrm_platform_role_id is obtained from the path parameter {roleId}. System auto-generates id (UUID), created_at (current timestamp), updated_at (current timestamp), and sets deleted_at to null. Validates permission_code against allowed values: 'org:manage', 'employee:manage', 'employee:view', 'project:manage', 'project:view', 'time:manage', 'time:approve', 'time:view_all', 'report:view'. Checks unique constraint on (hrm_platform_role_id, permission_code) to prevent duplicate permission assignments.

id.description: Unique identifier for the guest user. This UUID identifies the guest record in the system and is used to associate sessions and access patterns with the device fingerprint.
id.x-autobe-specification: Guest identifier extracted from hrm_platform_guests.id during authentication. This UUID is the primary key of the guest record that was created or retrieved based on device fingerprint matching. It serves as the guest's identity reference in the authorization response.

token.x-autobe-specification: Authorization token comes from the session table.

IHrmPlatformGuest.IAuthorized.description: Authorization response for guest authentication containing the guest's unique identifier and JWT tokens for session access. Guests are unauthenticated visitors identified by device fingerprint who receive temporary access tokens to interact with public resources. The access token is used for API requests, the refresh token for obtaining new access tokens, and the expiration timestamps indicate when the session expires.
IHrmPlatformGuest.IAuthorized.x-autobe-specification: Computed authorization response combining guest identity (id from hrm_platform_guests table) with JWT tokens generated by the authentication system. The id field is the guest's unique identifier from the database. The token field contains the IAuthorizationToken structure with access token, refresh token, expired_at, and refreshable_until timestamps. This DTO is used as the response body for guest join and refresh operations to provide authentication credentials to the client.

id.description: Unique identifier for the role permission assignment record.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_role_permissions.id. Primary key UUID identifying the permission assignment record.

permission_code.description: Permission identifier string defining the specific capability granted to the role. Examples include employee management, project viewing, time approval, and report access.
permission_code.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_role_permissions.permission_code. Stores the permission identifier string defining a specific capability. Valid values include 'org:manage', 'employee:manage', 'employee:view', 'project:manage', 'project:view', 'time:manage', 'time:approve', 'time:view_all', 'report:view'.

role.description: The role to which this permission is assigned. Contains role details including name, description, whether it's built-in or custom, and the organization it belongs to.
role.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping from hrm_platform_role_permissions.role relation. JOIN on hrm_platform_role_id = roles.id to hrm_platform_roles table. Returns IHrmPlatformRole.ISummary object with role details including id, name, description, is_builtin, built_in_type, created_at, organization, employee_count, and permission_count.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this permission was granted to the role.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_role_permissions.created_at. Timestamp when the permission was granted to the role. Stored as UTC datetime.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this permission assignment was last modified.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_role_permissions.updated_at. Timestamp when this permission assignment was last modified. Stored as UTC datetime.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this permission assignment was soft deleted. Null indicates the permission is currently active.
deleted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_role_permissions.deleted_at. Nullable timestamp indicating soft deletion. NULL means the permission is currently active. Non-NULL means the permission has been soft deleted and should be filtered out from active permission queries.

IHrmPlatformRolePermission.description: Role permission assignment record representing a specific capability granted to a role. This junction entity links roles to their permissions in the role-based access control system. Each record represents one permission (such as employee management, project viewing, or time approval) that has been assigned to a role. When employees are assigned to a role, they inherit all permissions associated with that role. Permission codes define specific capabilities including organization management, employee management, project management, time tracking operations, and report access.
IHrmPlatformRolePermission.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_role_permissions table. Fields: id, permission_code, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. Relation: role via JOIN on hrm_platform_role_id = roles.id to hrm_platform_roles table. Filter by deleted_at IS NULL for active permissions. Role relation transformed to IHrmPlatformRole.ISummary object with organization reference. Used as response body for POST /hrmPlatform/admin/roles/{roleId}/permissions (create permission) and GET /hrmPlatform/admin/roles/{roleId}/permissions/{permissionCode} (retrieve permission).

IHrmPlatformTask.IUpdate.description: Request body for updating an existing task. All fields are optional for partial updates. When status is modified, a task history entry is automatically created. Task assignment requires the employee to be an active member of the task's project. Parent task relationships enforce one-level subtask hierarchy.
IHrmPlatformTask.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Partial update DTO for hrm_platform_tasks table. All fields optional. Maps directly to database columns: title, description, status, priority, due_date, estimated_hours, assigned_employee_id, parent_task_id. Excluded fields: id (path parameter), created_by_member_id (from JWT), created_at/updated_at/deleted_at (auto-managed). Validation: status must be one of [open, in-progress, completed, closed], priority must be one of [low, medium, high, urgent], assigned_employee_id must reference active employee who is member of task's project, parent_task_id must reference task in same project that is not itself a subtask. Status change triggers automatic task history creation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the project in UUID format.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.id. UUID primary key that uniquely identifies the project within the organization. Auto-generated on record creation.

name.description: Project name that uniquely identifies the project within the organization. Used as the primary identifier for employees when selecting projects for time entries and task assignments.
name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.name. Required field with 1-100 character length. Must be unique within the organization (enforced by @@unique([organization_id, name]) constraint). Used as the primary identifier for employees when selecting projects for time entries and task assignments.

description.description: Optional description clarifying the project's purpose, scope, and boundaries. Helps employees understand which work belongs to this project when logging time.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.description. Optional nullable string field with maximum 2000 characters. Provides additional context about the project's purpose, scope, and boundaries to help employees understand which work belongs to which project when logging time.

status.description: Project lifecycle status. Valid values: 'active' (work in progress), 'completed' (work finished), 'archived' (historical reference). Completed and archived projects prevent new time entries.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.status. Required enum field with valid values: 'active' (work in progress, accepting time entries), 'completed' (work finished, read-only), 'archived' (historical reference, read-only). Completed and archived projects prevent new timelog additions while preserving existing time entries.

color_code.description: Color code for visual distinction across user interfaces. Enables employees to quickly identify projects when creating time entries, viewing reports, or browsing project lists.
color_code.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.color_code. Required non-empty string field for visual identification. Enables employees to quickly distinguish between multiple projects when creating time entries, viewing reports, or browsing project lists. Typically stored as hex color code.

budget_hours.description: Optional total estimated effort in hours for the project. Provides a baseline against which actual time logged can be compared for budget tracking.
budget_hours.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.budget_hours. Optional nullable double precision field representing the total estimated effort in hours for the project. Provides a baseline against which actual time logged can be compared to track whether work is proceeding within planned estimates. Used for budget consumption tracking and resource planning.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the project was created in ISO 8601 format.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.created_at. Auto-generated timestamp in ISO 8601 format (date-time) when the project record is created. Cannot be modified after creation. Used for sorting and filtering projects by creation date.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the project was last updated in ISO 8601 format.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.updated_at. Auto-generated timestamp in ISO 8601 format (date-time) that is automatically updated whenever the project record is modified. Used to track when the project was last changed.

deleted_at.description: Soft-deletion timestamp in ISO 8601 format. NULL if the project is active, set when the project is deleted.
deleted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.deleted_at. Nullable timestamp in ISO 8601 format (date-time) used for soft deletion. NULL means the project is active. When set, the project is marked as deleted but the record is preserved for audit trail and historical reference. Query automatically filters deleted_at IS NULL for active projects.

organization.description: The organization that owns this project. Projects are scoped to a single organization and cannot span multiple organizations.
organization.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping from hrm_platform_projects.organization_id FK to hrm_platform_organizations table via JOIN. Returns IHrmPlatformOrganization.ISummary object containing organization id, name, description, owner reference, settings, and logo. Projects are scoped to a single organization and cannot span multiple organizations. Organization context is enforced via authenticated user's employee record.

IHrmPlatformProject.description: Complete project entity representing a work container within an organization. Projects serve as the primary organizational structure for tracking time expenditures against specific business objectives. This entity includes all project attributes including visual identification (color_code), lifecycle status (active/completed/archived), budget tracking (budget_hours), and temporal boundaries. Projects can contain multiple project memberships linking employees to the project, and multiple tasks representing discrete work units. The organization reference provides context about which organization owns this project.
IHrmPlatformProject.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects table. Query filters deleted_at IS NULL for active projects. Fields: id (UUID primary key), name (unique per organization), description (nullable text), status (enum: active/completed/archived), color_code (hex string for visual identification), budget_hours (nullable double for effort estimation), created_at/updated_at (timestamps), deleted_at (nullable for soft delete). Relations: organization via JOIN on organization_id to hrm_platform_organizations (returns ISummary). Returns object with four keys: full_time, part_time, contractor, intern. Each key contains the count of employees with that employment type. Ensure all four keys are present even if count is zero.

Duration is stored in minutes, divide by 60 to get hours. Returns total hours logged across all employees for the current calendar week (Monday to Sunday).

average_hours_per_employee.x-autobe-specification: Query hrm_platform_timelogs JOIN hrm_platform_employees: AVG(SUM(duration)/60) GROUP BY employee_id WHERE organization_id = {current_org_id} AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND date >= {current_week_monday} AND date <= {current_week_sunday}. Calculate average of hours logged per active employee for the current week. Return 0 if no active employees have logged time.

top_performers.x-autobe-specification: Query hrm_platform_timelogs JOIN hrm_platform_employees: SELECT employee.*, SUM(duration)/60 as total_hours WHERE organization_id = {current_org_id} AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND date >= {current_week_monday} AND date <= {current_week_sunday} GROUP BY employee_id ORDER BY total_hours DESC LIMIT 5. Return array of IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary objects for the top 5 employees by hours logged in the current week.

pending_timesheets.description: Number of timesheets awaiting approval from managers.

IHrmPlatformEmployeeStatistic.description: Comprehensive employee statistics for the organization dashboard. Provides aggregated metrics about workforce health, utilization, and pending management actions including employee counts by status and employment type, time tracking metrics for the current week, timesheet workflow status, and budget utilization warnings for projects exceeding 80% capacity.
IHrmPlatformEmployeeStatistic.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation schema that aggregates data from multiple tables:

1. hrm_platform_employees: COUNT employees by status (active/deactivated) and employment_type (full_time, part_time, contractor, intern)
2. hrm_platform_timelogs: SUM duration for current week (Monday-Sunday), calculate average per active employee, identify top 5 performers by hours logged
3. hrm_platform_timesheets: COUNT by status (submitted/pending, approved, rejected) for current week
4. hrm_platform_projects: JOIN with timelogs to calculate budget utilization percentage, filter projects exceeding 80%

All aggregations scoped to organization context from admin session. Cache results for 5 minutes to reduce database load.

week_start_date.x-autobe-specification: Computed from DATE_TRUNC('week', date) on hrm_platform_timelogs.date column. Returns the Monday of each calendar week as a date string. This creates weekly buckets for grouping time entries.

billable_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(CASE WHEN billable = true THEN duration ELSE 0 END) / 60.0 from hrm_platform_timelogs. Filters only billable time entries (billable = true), sums their duration in minutes, and converts to hours with decimal precision.

non_billable_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(CASE WHEN billable = false THEN duration ELSE 0 END) / 60.0 from hrm_platform_timelogs. Filters only non-billable time entries (billable = false), sums their duration in minutes, and converts to hours with decimal precision.

IHrmPlatformTimeReport.IWeeklySummary.description: Weekly summary entry providing a detailed breakdown of time tracking data for a single calendar week. Each entry represents one week within the report date range and contains the week's start date (Monday) along with aggregated hour metrics including total hours worked, billable hours, and non-billable hours. This allows users to see how time was distributed week-by-week for the selected entity (employee, project, or task) rather than just viewing the aggregate total across the entire date range.
IHrmPlatformTimeReport.IWeeklySummary.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs grouped by calendar week.

Query Logic:
1. GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', date) to create weekly buckets
2. Within each group (employee/project/task), calculate per-week aggregates
3. For each week:
   - week_start_date: DATE_TRUNC('week', date) returns Monday of that week
   - total_hours: SUM(duration) / 60.0 for all timelogs in that week
   - billable_hours: SUM(CASE WHEN billable = true THEN duration ELSE 0 END) / 60.0
   - non_billable_hours: SUM(CASE WHEN billable = false THEN duration ELSE 0 END) / 60.0
4. Order by week_start_date ascending
5. Only included when weekly_summary parameter is true in IHrmPlatformTimeReport.IRequest

Join Requirements:
- hrm_platform_timelogs (source table)
- Filter by organization_id, date range, and grouping entity ID

Edge Cases:
- Weeks with no timelogs are not included in the array
- Partial weeks at start/end of date range are included with actual hours
- Empty array if no timelogs exist in the date range

This is a lightweight identity reference used across many entities (sessions, employees, organizations, invitations, activity logs) as a belongs-to relation.

IHrmPlatformMemberSession.ISummary.description: Lightweight summary of a member authentication session for audit trail display. Contains session identification information including IP address, href, referrer, and lifecycle timestamps (created_at, expired_at). Includes the authenticated member identity and optional active organization context. Counts all invitations (regardless of status) assigned to the specific role within the organization context, excluding soft-deleted records where deleted_at IS NULL.

IInvitationStatisticByRole.description: Invitation statistics for a specific role within the organization, showing the role identifier, role name, and total number of invitations assigned to that role. Provides a breakdown of the invitation pipeline by role type, helping administrators understand recruitment patterns and role distribution.
IInvitationStatisticByRole.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_employee_invitations JOIN hrm_platform_roles on hrm_platform_role_id = roles.id. Filter by organization_id matching current context and deleted_at IS NULL on both tables. GROUP BY hrm_platform_role_id to aggregate invitation count per role. SELECT roles.id as role_id, roles.name as role_name, COUNT(invitations.id) as invitation_count. Returns array of IInvitationStatisticByRole objects for role-based invitation breakdown.

employee.description: The employee who is a top performer by total hours logged during the specified period. Includes employee identity, employment classification, status, department assignment, and role information.
employee.x-autobe-specification: JOIN hrm_platform_employees on employee_id from the aggregated timelog results. Map employee data to IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary containing id, employment_type, status, created_at, member (IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary), department (IHrmPlatformDepartment.ISummary or null), and role (IHrmPlatformRole.ISummary). This provides the full employee identity and organizational context for each top performer.

totalHoursLogged.description: Total hours logged by the employee during the specified period. This is a computed sum of all timelog duration_hours for the employee within the date range, used to rank top performers.
totalHoursLogged.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SUM(duration_hours) from hrm_platform_timelogs grouped by employee_id. Applies date range filtering (startDate to endDate from request parameters) and organization context filtering (only timelogs from employees in the current organization). Returns a non-negative number representing the total hours worked by the employee during the specified period.

IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboardTopPerf.description: Top performer entry representing an employee ranked by total hours logged during the specified period. This type is used in the organization dashboard to display the top 5 employees by hours worked, helping administrators identify the most active contributors. Each entry includes the employee's identifying information and their total hours logged for the period.
IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboardTopPerf.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs and hrm_platform_employees tables:

1. Query hrm_platform_timelogs grouped by employee_id
2. Apply date range filters: WHERE date >= startDate AND date <= endDate (from request parameters)
3. Apply organization context: WHERE employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM hrm_platform_employees WHERE organization_id = {current_org_id})
4. Aggregate: SUM(duration_hours) as total_hours
5. Order by total_hours DESC
6. Limit to top 5 employees
7. JOIN with hrm_platform_employees to get employee details
8. Map employee data to IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary for employee field
9. Return array of objects with employee summary and hours logged

This schema represents a computed result set, not a direct database table mapping.

projectId.description: Unique identifier of the project that has exceeded its allocated budget hours.
projectId.x-autobe-specification: Sourced from hrm_platform_projects.id column. Unique identifier for the project that has exceeded its budget. Retrieved via JOIN with hrm_platform_timelogs on project_id.

projectName.description: Name of the project that has exceeded its allocated budget hours.
projectName.x-autobe-specification: Sourced from hrm_platform_projects.name column. Human-readable project name for display purposes. Retrieved via JOIN with hrm_platform_timelogs on project_id.

budgetHours.description: The originally allocated budget hours for the project.
budgetHours.x-autobe-specification: Sourced from hrm_platform_projects.budget_hours column. The originally allocated budget hours for the project. Only projects with non-null budget_hours are included in warnings.

actualHours.description: The total actual hours logged by employees on this project.
actualHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed via aggregation: SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration / 60.0) GROUP BY project_id. Duration is stored in minutes (Int), converted to hours for display. Represents total hours logged by all employees on this project across all timelog records.

overagePercentage.description: The percentage by which the project has exceeded its allocated budget hours.
overagePercentage.x-autobe-specification: Computed via formula: ((actualHours - budgetHours) / budgetHours) * 100. Rounded to 2 decimal places for display. Represents the percentage by which actual hours exceed the budget.

IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboardBudgetW.description: Budget warning record for a project that has exceeded its allocated budget hours. This type is used in the organization dashboard to alert administrators about projects requiring budget attention. Each warning includes the project identifier and name for easy identification, the originally allocated budget hours, the actual hours logged by employees, and the percentage by which the project has exceeded its budget. This information helps managers identify projects at risk of cost overruns and take corrective action such as extending budgets, reducing scope, or reallocating resources.
IHrmPlatformOrganizationDashboardBudgetW.x-autobe-specification:
Computed type aggregating project budget data from hrm_platform_projects and hrm_platform_timelogs.

1. Source Tables:
   - hrm_platform_projects: provides project id, name, budget_hours, organization_id
   - hrm_platform_timelogs: provides duration_hours for actual time logged

2. JOIN Condition:
   - hrm_platform_projects.id = hrm_platform_timelogs.project_id
   - hrm_platform_projects.organization_id = {current_organization_id}

3. Aggregation:
   - actualHours: SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_hours) GROUP BY project_id
   - budgetHours: hrm_platform_projects.budget_hours (direct mapping)

4. Filtering:
   - Only include projects where budget_hours IS NOT NULL
   - Only include projects where actualHours > budget_hours (overage condition)
   - Filter by organization context from authenticated user session

5. Calculation:
   - overagePercentage: ((actualHours - budgetHours) / budgetHours) * 100
   - Round to 2 decimal places for display

6. Edge Cases:
   - If no timelogs exist for a project, actualHours = 0 (would not trigger warning)
   - If budget_hours is null, exclude from budget warnings list
   - Handle division by zero if budget_hours = 0 (should not occur due to validation)

projectId.description: Unique identifier of the project. Represents the project where the employee has logged time, mapped from the timelog's project reference.
projectId.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs.project_id, mapped to hrm_platform_projects.id. SELECT project_id FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} GROUP BY project_id. Returns UUID of the project that the employee has logged time against.

projectName.description: Display name of the project. Retrieved from the project record to provide human-readable project identification in workload reports and dashboards.
projectName.x-autobe-specification: Computed via JOIN: SELECT projects.name FROM hrm_platform_timelogs JOIN hrm_platform_projects ON timelogs.project_id = projects.id WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} GROUP BY project_id, projects.name. Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.name column. Filtered to exclude soft-deleted projects (deleted_at IS NULL).

colorCode.x-autobe-specification: Computed via JOIN: SELECT projects.color_code FROM hrm_platform_timelogs JOIN hrm_platform_projects ON timelogs.project_id = projects.id WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} GROUP BY project_id, projects.color_code. Direct mapping from hrm_platform_projects.color_code column. NULL if project has no color configured - UI must handle gracefully.
colorCode.description: Color code for project visual identification in dashboards and reports. May be null if the project has no color configured.

hoursLogged.description: Total hours logged by the employee on this project. Calculated by summing all timelog durations (in minutes) for the project and converting to hours. Represents the employee's time investment in the project for workload analysis.
hoursLogged.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SELECT SUM(duration_minutes) / 60.0 FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id = {employeeId} GROUP BY project_id. Steps: 1) Sum all duration_minutes from timelogs for this employee and project, 2) Divide by 60 to convert minutes to hours, 3) Result is a decimal number representing total hours worked on the project. Minimum value is 0.

IHrmPlatformEmployee.IWorkloadProjectHou.description: Project-level breakdown of hours logged by an employee. Each entry represents a single project with the total hours the employee has worked on that project. Used in workload statistics to show time distribution across different projects. The hours are calculated by summing all timelog durations for the project and converting from minutes to hours. Includes project identifier, name, and color code for display purposes in dashboards and reports.
IHrmPlatformEmployee.IWorkloadProjectHou.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation type combining data from hrm_platform_timelogs and hrm_platform_projects tables:

1. Data Source: hrm_platform_timelogs filtered by employee_id, grouped by project_id
2. Join: LEFT JOIN hrm_platform_projects ON timelogs.project_id = projects.id
3. Filter: Only include non-deleted projects (projects.deleted_at IS NULL)
4. Aggregation: SUM(duration_minutes) per project, divided by 60 to convert to hours
5. Sort: Results ordered by hours_logged descending in parent array

Computation Steps:
- Query hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id = {targetEmployeeId}
- GROUP BY project_id to aggregate hours per project
- SUM(duration_minutes) for each project group
- Divide sum by 60 to convert minutes to hours
- JOIN with hrm_platform_projects to retrieve project.name and project.color_code
- Filter out soft-deleted projects (deleted_at IS NULL)
- Return array of project hour breakdowns

Edge Cases:
- Empty array if employee has no timelogs
- NULL color_code handled gracefully if project has no color set
- Only includes projects where employee has logged time

employee.description: The employee who has logged the most hours on this project. Contains employee identification details including employment type, status, member account, department assignment, and role.
employee.x-autobe-specification: Transform hrm_platform_employee_id from the most active project membership to IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary object via JOIN on hrm_platform_employees. This represents the employee record of the team member who has logged the most hours on the project. Query joins hrm_platform_project_memberships.employee_id to hrm_platform_employees.id to retrieve employee details.

totalHoursLogged.description: Total number of hours logged by this employee on the project. Calculated as the sum of all timelog durations (in minutes) divided by 60 to convert to hours.
totalHoursLogged.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SUM(duration)/60 from hrm_platform_timelogs where employee_id matches the most active team member AND project_id matches the current project AND deleted_at IS NULL. The duration field is in minutes, so divide by 60 to convert to hours. Returns a decimal number representing total hours.

totalTimelogs.description: Total number of time entries (timelogs) logged by this employee on the project. Represents the count of individual work sessions recorded.
totalTimelogs.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_timelogs where employee_id matches the most active team member AND project_id matches the current project AND deleted_at IS NULL. Returns an integer representing the total number of time entries logged by this employee on the project.

IHrmPlatformProjectMostActiveMember.description: The most active team member on a project, representing the employee who has logged the most hours. This type provides quick identification of the top contributor without requiring clients to parse the complete team members list. Includes employee identification details and aggregated time tracking metrics (total hours logged and number of time entries).
IHrmPlatformProjectMostActiveMember.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation type representing the most active team member on a project. Data sources: 1) Query hrm_platform_project_memberships to get all team members for the project (filter deleted_at IS NULL). 2) For each team member, aggregate from hrm_platform_timelogs: SUM(duration)/60 = totalHoursLogged, COUNT(*) = totalTimelogs. 3) Sort team members by totalHoursLogged descending. 4) Select the first member (highest hours). 5) Transform hrm_platform_employee_id to IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary object via JOIN on hrm_platform_employees. Return null if no team members have logged any time or if teamMembers array is empty.

employee.description: The employee assigned to this project. Contains complete employee summary including their member identity, department assignment, and role information.
employee.x-autobe-specification: Computed employee object from JOIN between hrm_platform_project_memberships and hrm_platform_employees. Returns IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary containing employee identity (id, employment_type, status, created_at), associated member (id, email, created_at), department (nullable), and role information. The employee is linked through project_memberships.hrm_platform_employee_id → employees.id join.

totalHoursLogged.description: Total hours logged by this team member on the project, calculated by summing all timelog durations and converting from minutes to hours.
totalHoursLogged.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: SUM(duration) / 60 from hrm_platform_timelogs where hrm_platform_employee_id matches the employee.id and deleted_at IS NULL. Converts total duration from minutes to hours. Returns 0 if no timelogs exist for this employee.

totalTimelogs.description: Total number of time entries (timelogs) created by this team member for the project.
totalTimelogs.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: COUNT(*) from hrm_platform_timelogs where hrm_platform_employee_id matches the employee.id and deleted_at IS NULL. Returns the total number of time entries created by this employee for the project. Returns 0 if no timelogs exist.

averageDailyHours.description: Average hours worked per day by this team member on the project, calculated by dividing average daily duration by the number of unique work days.
averageDailyHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: AVG(duration / 60) / COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(date)) from hrm_platform_timelogs where hrm_platform_employee_id matches the employee.id and deleted_at IS NULL. Calculates the average hours worked per unique day. Returns 0 if no timelogs exist or if COUNT(DISTINCT DATE) is 0.

lastActivityDate.description: The date of the most recent time entry for this team member on the project. Null if the employee has not yet logged any time.
lastActivityDate.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation: MAX(date) from hrm_platform_timelogs where hrm_platform_employee_id matches the employee.id and deleted_at IS NULL. Returns the most recent date when this employee logged time for the project. Returns null if no timelogs exist for this employee.

IHrmPlatformProjectTeamActivityMember.description: Time tracking activity summary for a single team member assigned to a project. Contains the employee's identity information along with aggregated metrics showing their total hours logged, number of time entries, average daily hours, and date of most recent activity. This data enables project leads to understand individual team member contributions and identify active contributors. Team members with no time entries are included with zero values to maintain complete team visibility.
IHrmPlatformProjectTeamActivityMember.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation DTO for project team activity reporting. Query joins hrm_platform_project_memberships with hrm_platform_employees to get all team members assigned to a project, then LEFT JOINs with hrm_platform_timelogs to aggregate time tracking data per employee.

Query structure:
1. SELECT employee.id, employee.employment_type, employee.status, employee.created_at, member.id, member.email, member.created_at, department.id, department.name, role.id, role.name, role.is_builtin
2. FROM hrm_platform_project_memberships WHERE hrm_platform_project_id = {projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
3. JOIN hrm_platform_employees ON hrm_platform_employee_id = employees.id AND employees.deleted_at IS NULL
4. JOIN hrm_platform_members ON employees.member_id = members.id AND members.deleted_at IS NULL
5. LEFT JOIN hrm_platform_departments ON employees.department_id = departments.id AND departments.deleted_at IS NULL
6. JOIN hrm_platform_roles ON employees.role_id = roles.id AND roles.deleted_at IS NULL
7. LEFT JOIN hrm_platform_timelogs ON employees.id = timelogs.hrm_platform_employee_id AND timelogs.deleted_at IS NULL
8. GROUP BY employee.id, member.id, department.id, role.id
9. Aggregate: SUM(duration)/60 → totalHoursLogged, COUNT(*) → totalTimelogs, AVG(duration/60)/COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(date)) → averageDailyHours, MAX(date) → lastActivityDate

Edge cases handled:
- Team members with no timelogs included with 0 values and null lastActivityDate
- Only active (non-deleted) records included
- Organization context filtering implicit from authenticated user's employee record

IHrmPlatformDepartment.ITopLevel.description:
A top-level department with its direct child departments.

This type represents a department that has no parent (top-level in the hierarchy) along with an array of its direct child departments. It is used in the department hierarchy endpoint to provide a tree structure for displaying organizational units.

The childDepartments array contains only direct children - the hierarchy is limited to one level of nesting as per system constraints. Each child department is represented as a summary with essential display information.
IHrmPlatformDepartment.ITopLevel.x-autobe-specification:
Top-level department with child departments for hierarchical display.

Direct mappings from hrm_platform_departments table:
- id: from departments.id (UUID)
- name: from departments.name (String)
- description: from departments.description (String?, nullable)
- created_at: from departments.created_at (DateTime)
- updated_at: from departments.updated_at (DateTime)

Child departments:
- childDepartments: Array of child departments where parent_id = this department's id
- Query child departments with JOIN on parent_id = parent.id
- Use IHrmPlatformDepartment.ISummary for each child department
- Sort children by name
- Only one level of nesting (children cannot have their own children in this structure)

Filter: parent_id IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL to get only active top-level departments.
